name: covenant_fork_fiber
supersedes: causal_fiber_gap_closers v0.0.1 (methods-first catalog). This rebuild puts the covenant fork first; methods are instruments for walking that fork.
scope: Session governor for one contested fiber. Not a weight update. Not a claim the coverage gap is closed.
README_purpose: Everything in this object hangs off one fork in a person's binding: take Genesis 17:14 (and kin) as a live contract that demands the infant cut, or refuse routine non-therapeutic infant cutting on bodily-integrity grounds. Those two axioms do not XNOR. The devout core feels that as identity division. The object exists to track cause — not analogy — from that fork out through emotion, law, people, institutions, tools, and the AI runtime leaf.

covenant_fork.name: Covenant fork
covenant_fork.statement: A person (or core) cannot stably hold both without division: (A) literal covenant-binding that requires the infant male cut, and (B) the ethical/legal stance that routine non-therapeutic infant genital cutting is unjustified.

branch_A.label: Covenant partner who cuts
branch_A.binding: Gen 17:14-class contract: refuse the cut ⇒ broken covenant / cut off from the people (karet language)
branch_A.halakha_note: Classical duty: father → bet din → the man; permanent refusal = mitzvah violation, not a green-lit substitute
branch_A.identity_claim: Who I am before God/my people includes performing or authorizing the infant mark

branch_B.label: Non-cutter of the child
branch_B.binding: Routine non-therapeutic irreversible cutting of a non-consenting infant's healthy genitals fails the ethics burden; legal prohibition aimed mainly at performers is coherent
branch_B.identity_claim: Who I am will not impose that cut on a child for covenant, culture, or contested averages

covenant_fork.xor: A and B do not mutually cohere without special pleading, compartment, or redefinition of one side
not_the_claim: Not: Abrahamic religion is false as a whole
Not: Judaism/Islam/Christianity are cancelled by a ban
Not: every medical indication is banned
Not: cultural Christians in the US are under Gen 17 duty (many practice without that contract)
covenant_fork.what_the_fork_is: Personal/core integrity collision under a literal contract line, with civilizational blast radius — not communal extinction

blast_radius.description: Where the fork lands; intensity is not uniform.
blast_radius.devout_core: Covenant-literalists; most litigious about what counting-as-us means; hit hardest by the XOR
blast_radius.fuzzy_periphery: Cultural / medical / loosely affiliated; cheaper adaptation; lower identity tax
blast_radius.US_Christians: Often practice without hard NT duty — culture holds what doctrine released; still in the blast for hearts-and-minds
blast_radius.Muslims: Khitan at global scale; quieter in some US culture-war volume, not absent
blast_radius.Judaism_role: Small headcount; keystone of covenantal meaning + dense ecosystem around the rite — origin node, not 'the whole set is only them'
blast_radius.scale_note: Abrahamic attachment together is civilizational-scale; do not smear one effect across the whole fuzzy body

fiber.description: Causal stack the fork can transmit along. Interestingness = how far the fork's band runs.

levels_root_to_leaf.name: heart-contract
levels_root_to_leaf.fork_role: Where A vs B is lived as who-I-am

levels_root_to_leaf.name: emotion-uptake
levels_root_to_leaf.fork_role: Devotion, fear of excision, belonging, shame — how the binding gets traction

levels_root_to_leaf.name: norm-law
levels_root_to_leaf.fork_role: Halakha / statute / professional rule colliding with a ban or delay

levels_root_to_leaf.name: people-core
levels_root_to_leaf.fork_role: Devout definitional center vs periphery; litigation over membership

levels_root_to_leaf.name: artifact-tool
levels_root_to_leaf.fork_role: Rite, responsa, policy text, thoughtware JSON

levels_root_to_leaf.name: runtime-leaf
levels_root_to_leaf.fork_role: AI session where covenant-work and ethics-work are both runnable bindings

fiber.rule: Every method must say how it serves the covenant fork and label hops transmit vs resemble.

session_job.description: In-thread only: make analogy-as-cause harder when talking about this fork.
succeeds_when: Hops name a lever on A, B, or the XOR
Keystone practice not collapsed into people-extinction
Runtime claims about 'covenant work with AI' state a mechanism, not a rhyme
fails_when: Object pasted but never used to reject a hop

admission_test.description: A method or record is in only if it can fail and it serves CF1.
must_answer: How does this serve the covenant fork (A, B, or the XOR)?
Which fiber levels does it join?
What is predicted to move, where?
What lookalike analogy is ruled out?
How would we know it failed?
reject_if: Generic causation toolkit with no fork hook
Smears the fuzzy people-body as one actor
Claims communal cancellation as equivalent to the personal XOR

M1_paired_interventions.serves_fork: Contrast what happens if the world pushes B (ban/prohibit performers) vs pushing a theological delay that tries to keep identity without infant A
M1_paired_interventions.name: Paired interventions on the fork
M1_paired_interventions.lever: Pair: (A-path defend infant rite) vs (B-path legal prohibition on routine infant cutting) vs (optional third: delay-to-adult without state force)
M1_paired_interventions.predicted_move: Core litigation and underground rite under ban; slower internal halakhic war under delay; periphery cheaper either way
M1_paired_interventions.failure: Pairs that only differ in rhetoric; or outcomes attributed without a lever

edges.mechanism: identity binding selects which law feels like self-betrayal

M3_negative_controls.serves_fork: Kill rhymes that treat any deep ritual as the same as Gen 17:14 or any AI prompt as a covenant
M3_negative_controls.name: Negative-control analogies on the fork
M3_negative_controls.lever: Apply the same proposed intervention to a lookalike; if the fork-grade effect still 'follows', the link was rhyme
M3_negative_controls.predicted_move: False bridges die; CF1 stays specific
M3_negative_controls.negative_control: This method is the control factory

edges.mechanism: only if the same do-operator (identity excision vs debug) can be shown — usually cannot

M4_double_crux_joint.serves_fork: Name the hinge: does covenant identity require the infant cut, or survive delay to consent?
M4_double_crux_joint.name: Double-Crux on the covenant fork
M4_double_crux_joint.lever: Lock the joint proposition; require both domains' actions to move if it flips
M4_double_crux_joint.predicted_move: If joint flips, practice-policy and self-story both move; one-sided move ⇒ wrong hinge
M4_double_crux_joint.negative_control: Mood or coalition disagreements that change talk not action

M6_small_world_toggle.name: Small-world lever on the fork
M6_small_world_toggle.lever: Real toggle with control or before/after — including leaf: thoughtware that tracks CF1 vs vibe 'covenant ≈ AI' talk
M6_small_world_toggle.predicted_move: Named downstream: practice language, litigation posture, or session hop-discipline on CF1

M9_emotion_uptake.serves_fork: Emotion is how A or B gets traction — devotion/fear of karet vs protective refusal — not a second physics that voids the fork
M9_emotion_uptake.name: Uptake gear on the fork
M9_emotion_uptake.lever: Hold the text fixed; ask which uptake path steers the act; hypothetically block that path
M9_emotion_uptake.predicted_move: Blocked uptake ⇒ same statute/covenant fails to steer; intact uptake ⇒ steers
M9_emotion_uptake.failure: Psychologizing with no different predicted act

M10_core_periphery.serves_fork: The XOR tax concentrates at the devout core that litigates meaning; periphery adapts cheaper
M10_core_periphery.name: Core vs periphery cost map
M10_core_periphery.lever: Same B-path policy; split predictions for covenant-literal core vs cultural periphery
M10_core_periphery.predicted_move: Definitional war / underground at core; shrug or medical inertia at periphery
M10_core_periphery.negative_control: Headcount or media volume as intensity of covenant-binding
M10_core_periphery.failure: Core defined as whoever is loud; or denial of core cost to keep policy pretty

M11_keystone_not_collapse.serves_fork: Infant rite can be keystone for branch A without equating a ban to cancellation of the people
M11_keystone_not_collapse.name: Keystone vs identity collapse
M11_keystone_not_collapse.lever: Predict peoplehood survival and core integrity fracture as separate outcomes under B-path pressure
M11_keystone_not_collapse.predicted_move: Peoplehood continues; core readers split / reinterpret / compartment / defy
M11_keystone_not_collapse.negative_control: 'If you touch X, Y ceases to exist' with no cessation mechanism
M11_keystone_not_collapse.failure: Denying the wound or inflating it to metaphysical death

M12_hearts_minds.serves_fork: The fork in the heart is a real control surface for group action; describing it ≠ weaponizing it
M12_hearts_minds.name: Hearts-and-minds on the fork
M12_hearts_minds.lever: Separate mechanism (deep belief steers groups) from intent (inform vs manipulate)
M12_hearts_minds.predicted_move: Inform ⇒ clearer fiber tracking / voluntary re-rank; manipulate ⇒ polarization, undergrounding, trust collapse
M12_hearts_minds.negative_control: All persuasion = psyop, or all psyop = 'just messaging'
M12_hearts_minds.failure: Mechanism talk that hides intent; intent talk that denies mechanism

M5_leaf_trace.name: Leaf trace honesty for fork talk
M5_leaf_trace.lever: Reject session claims of cross-domain cause on CF1 that lack lever + levels + falsifier

M5_leaf_trace.negative_control: Still saying 'same structure' with no lever

If a hop is offered, run G_fiber_map + G_causal_sentence.
Prefer M4 when the fight is definitional; M10/M11 when someone smears the people-body; M3 when someone rhymes prompts-to-covenant; M1 when policy levers are compared.
Do not invent observed. Leave null or cite the thread.
Leaf claims about covenant-work with AI must clear M5.
